description: 近 24 小时硬件状态；一分钟聚合，缺测保留断点。准备稿：各盘剩余空间尚缺现有时序指标，外部分享尚未启用。

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, now() - interval '24 hours') AS start_time,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS end_time
), time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('minute', start_time), date_trunc('minute', end_time), interval '1 minute') AS time
  FROM bounds
), points AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, AVG(system_ram_usage_pct) AS value
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware, bounds
  WHERE timestamp >= bounds.start_time AND timestamp <= bounds.end_time
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT g.time AS "time", p.value AS "物理内存占用"
FROM time_grid g LEFT JOIN points p ON p.time = g.time
ORDER BY 1;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, now() - interval '24 hours') AS p_from,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS p_to,
         GREATEST(60, extract(epoch FROM ('$__interval')::interval)::integer) AS step
), state AS (
  SELECT a.*, r.raw_since AS cutoff, CASE WHEN r.summaries_ready AND a.step >= 3600 AND a.step % 3600 = 0
    THEN r.summarized_until ELSE r.raw_since END AS covered_until
  FROM args a CROSS JOIN public.activity_retention_state r WHERE r.singleton AND a.p_to > a.p_from
), bounds AS (
  SELECT *, date_trunc('hour', GREATEST(p_from, cutoff)) + CASE WHEN GREATEST(p_from, cutoff) >
    date_trunc('hour', GREATEST(p_from, cutoff)) THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '0' END AS full_from,
    LEAST(date_trunc('hour', p_to), covered_until) AS full_to FROM state
), samples AS (
  SELECT a.timestamp, sum(a.proc_network_send_kb::double precision) AS send_kb,
         sum(a.proc_network_recv_kb::double precision) AS recv_kb
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE a.timestamp >= GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, now() - interval '24 hours')
    AND a.timestamp < LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now())
    AND a.timestamp >= GREATEST(b.p_from, b.cutoff) AND a.timestamp < b.p_to
    AND (b.full_to <= b.full_from OR a.timestamp < b.full_from OR a.timestamp >= b.full_to)
  GROUP BY a.timestamp
), stats AS (
  SELECT date_bin(make_interval(secs => b.step), s.timestamp, '2000-01-01 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz) AS time,
    s.send_kb AS send_sum, (s.send_kb IS NOT NULL)::integer AS send_count,
    s.recv_kb AS recv_sum, (s.recv_kb IS NOT NULL)::integer AS recv_count FROM samples s CROSS JOIN bounds b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date_bin(make_interval(secs => GREATEST(b.step,3600)), h.bucket_start, '2000-01-01 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz),
    h.proc_network_send_kb_sum, h.proc_network_send_kb_count, h.proc_network_recv_kb_sum, h.proc_network_recv_kb_count
  FROM public.activity_system_hour h CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE h.bucket_start < b.covered_until AND h.bucket_start < b.p_to AND h.bucket_start >= date_trunc('hour',b.p_from)
    AND (h.bucket_start < b.cutoff OR (h.bucket_start >= b.p_from AND h.bucket_start + interval '1 hour' <= b.p_to))
    AND NOT (b.step >= 86400 AND date_trunc('day',h.bucket_start,'Asia/Shanghai') >= b.p_from
      AND date_trunc('day',h.bucket_start,'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '1 day' <= LEAST(b.p_to,b.covered_until))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date_bin(make_interval(secs => GREATEST(b.step,3600)), d.bucket_start, '2000-01-01 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz),
    d.proc_network_send_kb_sum, d.proc_network_send_kb_count, d.proc_network_recv_kb_sum, d.proc_network_recv_kb_count
  FROM public.activity_system_day d CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE b.step >= 86400 AND d.bucket_start >= b.p_from
    AND d.bucket_start + interval '1 day' <= LEAST(b.p_to,b.covered_until)
), points AS (
  SELECT time, ROUND((sum(send_sum)/NULLIF(sum(send_count),0))::numeric,6)*1024.0 AS "上传",
    ROUND((sum(recv_sum)/NULLIF(sum(recv_count),0))::numeric,6)*1024.0 AS "下载" FROM stats GROUP BY time
), ordered AS (
  SELECT *, lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS previous_time FROM points
), gaps AS (
  SELECT *, make_interval(secs => CASE WHEN previous_time < (SELECT cutoff FROM bounds)
    THEN GREATEST((SELECT step FROM bounds),3600) ELSE (SELECT step FROM bounds) END) AS expected_step FROM ordered
)
SELECT time, "上传", "下载" FROM points
UNION ALL SELECT previous_time + expected_step, NULL::double precision, NULL::double precision FROM gaps
WHERE time > previous_time + expected_step ORDER BY time;
